morning.title: Arrive and settle in
morning.description: Land at Humberto Delgado airport and take the metro to the hotel.

afternoon.title: Alfama walk
afternoon.description: Wander the narrow lanes up to the Sao Jorge Castle viewpoint.

evening.title: Fado dinner
evening.description: Dinner with live fado in a small tasca.

morning.title: Jeronimos Monastery
morning.description: Visit the monastery early to beat the queues.

afternoon.title: Belem Tower and pasteis
afternoon.description: Walk the riverfront to the tower, then try pasteis de nata.

evening.title: LX Factory
evening.description: Browse shops and eat dinner in a converted factory.

morning.title: Pena Palace
morning.description: Take the early train to Sintra and head up to the palace.

afternoon.title: Quinta da Regaleira
afternoon.description: Explore the gardens and the initiation well.

morning.title: Time Out Market
morning.description: Breakfast and gifts at the food hall.

afternoon.title: Departure
afternoon.description: Collect bags and head to the airport.

tips: Buy a rechargeable Viva Viagem card for metro and trams.
Wear shoes with grip: the cobbles get slippery.
